1_zero_rear_labels_in_sync11_and_long_dr.reason: Pre-db40305 unrotated -90 deg camera_2 streams produced 0/11 'rear' boxes and up to 43.2 s internal blind gaps (event_017), triggering RULE_L4_BACK_SPARSE_DROPOUT_HOLD.

2_mid_passage_false_rear_boxes_on_unsync.example_event_004: Intermittent rear dets at 8.0, 19.0, 44.0 s occur up to 68.8 s before T4_back=76.8 s.

4_missing_physical_occupancy_sensor.impact: Even with upright dense Session 2 back detections (events 021-023: 208-230 dets, 4-14 rear boxes near T4), missing physical occupancy sensors force V3 to remain CLOSED in REAR_CONFIRMED/TRAIN_DEPARTING (fail-closed hold != autonomous completion).

independent_crossings.target_total_crossings: >= 5 disjoint crossings (2 train, 1 val, 2 test; vs invalid 3-crossing floor)
independent_crossings.rationale: Eliminates background geometry, barrier appearance, acoustic reverberation, and crossing-specific false-alarm leakage while preventing single-crossing test fragility.

minimum_balanced_sessions.minimum_sessions_per_crossing: 2-3 balanced sessions per crossing spanning 2x2 Day/Night x Clear/Adverse-Weather strata

hardware_and_synchronization_protocol: Use identical camera hardware across train/no_train/engine cohorts within each session (no mid-cohort iPhone-to-iPad swap).

Lock orientation metadata upright or maintain strict orthogonal rotation tags; verify NTP/GPS clock sync plus an audible/visual slate clapper at session start & end to establish sub-100ms front-back sync across ALL events (eliminating the 15 non-CALIBRATION_SUPPORTED events).

Treat 84–211 m upstream distance (7.6 s closure budget at 40–100 km/h) as an unvalidated kinematic engineering estimate until verified via site-specific lens focal length, small-object pixel height (>= 24–32 px at 416 px), curvature, >= 10 s pre-T0 buffer, AND >= 15 s post-T4 tail buffer.
Record independent occupancy ground truth (calibrated overhead crossing camera or inductive/radar occupancy logger) plus dedicated lateral crossing-box FOV.

structural_floor_critique.why_insufficient: A structural minimum of 3 crossings x 2 sessions (~12 test trains, ~6 test no_train clips) leaves 0/12 premature openings with a 22.09% one-sided 95% upper bound (39.30% on 0/6 false closures), gives only 1.87% two-sided McNemar power at p10=0.20 (24.37% at p10=4/11), and leaves only 1 crossing in val and test.
